standard.summary: ReFT（Representation Fine-tuning）不修改模型权重，而是在模型输出上叠加一个低秩干预向量，用极少的可训练参数实现模型行为调整。
standard.effect: reft_rank 控制干预向量的秩（默认 8）。reft_target_modules 指定在哪些模块上施加干预。reft_init_scale 控制初始化缩放。
standard.whenToUse: 想用比 LoRA 更少参数实现模型微调时。实验性特性。
standard.avoidWhen: 推理端需要支持 ReFT 格式。标准 LoRA 推理管线不兼容。

standard_en.summary: ReFT (Representation Fine-tuning) does not modify the model's weights; it adds a low-rank intervention vector on top of the model's output, adjusting model behaviour with very few trainable parameters.
standard_en.effect: reft_rank controls the intervention vector's rank (default 8). reft_target_modules names the modules the intervention applies to. reft_init_scale controls the initialisation scale.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you want to finetune with fewer parameters than a LoRA. An experimental feature.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When the inference side has to support the ReFT format. A standard LoRA inference pipeline is not compatible.

advanced.principle: ReFT 在指定层的输出 h 上叠加干预：h' = h + R·(v - h)，其中 R 是低秩投影矩阵（rank × hidden_dim），v 是可训练干预向量。reft_rank 控制 R 的秩。这比 LoRA 参数更少（只学 R 和 v，不学 矩阵对）。
advanced.intervention: 在指定模块的 forward hook 中叠加干预向量。
advanced.expectedImpact: 参数量比 LoRA 少约 50%。效果取决于任务和 rank 选择。
advanced.tradeoffs: reft_init_scale=0 时初始无效果（从零开始学）。
advanced.codePath: core/lulynx/ → ReFT intervention layer → forward hook injection

advanced_en.principle: ReFT superimposes an intervention on the output h of specified layers: h' = h + R·(v - h), where R is a low-rank projection matrix (rank × hidden_dim) and v is a trainable intervention vector. reft_rank controls R's rank. It uses fewer parameters than LoRA (it learns only R and v, not the matrix pair).
advanced_en.intervention: Applies the intervention vector in forward hooks of the specified modules.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: About 50% fewer parameters than LoRA. Effectiveness depends on the task and rank choice.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: With reft_init_scale=0 there is initially no effect (it learns from zero).
advanced_en.codePath: core/lulynx/ → ReFT intervention layer → forward hook injection
